Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
DOC-0034 2026-08-08
MEMORANDUM
Date: 2026-08-08
To: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA queue coordinators
From: PERSON-0019, TEAM-0001
Subject: Station 03 Receives the Electrical Queue Binder
Decision: On 2026-09-01 at 09:40, the queue-paper binder for DEMO-AIR-0012
will move from the DEMO-STATION-01 coordination desk to the
DEMO-STATION-08 receiving desk. This changes custody of the coordination
papers only; the aircraft's station field is outside this arrangement.
The sending clerk keeps the source index and a transfer receipt. The receiving
clerk receives the binder, its attachment index, and the diary of promised
contacts. Use ISSUE-0107 and TASK-0987 as locating references for the
electrical section when checking that both desks can navigate the same index.
Use receiver echo at the transfer conversation. The receiving coordinator
repeats the next administrative action and its due date, and the sending clerk
writes that response on the receipt. A delivery acknowledgement alone does
not identify who will carry the next queue action.
geen
If the receiving desk cannot take the scheduled appointment, retain custody at
the sending desk and record a revised transfer time with the station
coordinator. Keep the original appointment visible so the change can be
traced.
Implementation: PERSON-0019 will prepare the source-index copy on
2026-08-31. The receiving desk coordinator will confirm the transfer contact
before that date. The source station will retain its index for later reference
questions and direct new binder requests to the receiving desk after the
documented handover.
D. Worker 0017
Demo Worker 0019, Demo Team 01
